I was disappointed that I wasn't fully informed from the start. To my knowledge, and in my country, the treatment involves combining root canal treatment with a filling. I was told that this pricing was due to "the urgent nature of your tooth," but who would go to a clinic for a non-urgent situation? I'm satisfied with the treatment; however, having to pay extra each time I went has disrupted all my financial plans. They keep scheduling new appointments, so you have to go to the clinic constantly.

I was also told that there was a small crack in part of my tooth after the root canal treatment. After each new session I went to, I felt like they were trying to sell me something.🥺
